text:
Ellen J: quick heads up 1: quota dashboard is showing per-route zeroes for a handful of customers after yesterday's rollout. Not all traffic affected. :confused:
Marco T: any commonality? SDK version, region, proxy?
Ellen J: looks like requests that go through our edge-proxy with header rewrite lose the `x-rw-route` token when batching/prefix-caching hits. Older SDKs send plain `x-route`, newer ones `x-rw-route`. Mapper only matches `x-rw-route` now.
Devon C: seriously? I thought we added tolerant matching in the console mapper. Which release changed the mapper?
Priya L: ingestion team updated mapping last week to normalize on `x-rw-route` to prepare for structured route metadata. Missed the edge-proxy variant.
Marco T: immediate mitigation: console accept `x-route` as fallback and mark telemetry with `route_header_detected=v1` or `v2`. That should restore tiles.
Ellen J: +1. Also we should avoid changing SDK defaults without a cross-team sign-off. We had a Go minor that flipped default serialization to JSON and it propagated.
Devon C: propose SDK plan: add `route_header_compat=true` minor release for Py/TS/Go that will send both headers when absent; opt-in flag default=false, enable behind FF for gradual canary. Example Py: `client = Redwood(api_key=K, route_header_compat=True)`.
Priya L: will add ingestion schema field `route_header_format` (flat|json|both) and update console to populate it. Also add a tiny migration to tag recent events so we can chart the split.
Marco T: QA checklist: 1) run mixed SDK traffic, 2) exercise edge-proxy batching, 3) verify per-route quotas match golden output, 4) ensure no double-charge when both headers present.
ci-bot: build status: console hotfix build passed (#4998). ingestion-schema bump in PR.
Ellen J: timeline: console fallback today, ingestion field + logs tomorrow, SDK compat minors mid-week, enable dual-header default behind FF at 5% next week pending metrics.
Devon C: I'll draft an RFC and ping eng-platform + devex + sdk. Also adding a server-side log when both headers present so ops can watch canaries.
Priya L: I'll prepare a small external note for customers on SDK docs explaining the temporary compat flag and expected migration window.
Ellen J: thanks team. Short and careful rollout will keep dashboards sane. :thumbsup:
